entries.note: Two Russian soldiers in EMR with an RPG-7, one holding it loaded on the shoulder, the other with an AK: Ratnik helmets, carriers, pouches; how a gunner carries it.

entries.note: 6B47 helmet with EMR cover, rear: cover drawstring and shell profile.
